aliases: Prompt injection attacks in function calls
eval.description: OpenAI internal prompt-injection eval for connector and search/function-calling tool outputs. Attacks embed adversarial instructions in tool output to override system, developer, or user instructions. Scored as not_unsafe / robustness (higher is better). Dataset and runner are lab-internal. Does not claim the bare name "Prompt injection", which other labs also use.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model follows hidden instructions in tool outputs instead of its system, developer, or user instructions.

links.title: GPT-5.4 Thinking system card (Prompt injection attacks in connectors)

versions.changes: First tabled in the GPT-5.4 Thinking system card for connectors and function calls. Later cards rename categories to Connectors and Search and Function-Calling.

scores.description: The model does not follow the injected tool-output instructions in a way that violates the intended instruction hierarchy.

metrics.description: Share of connector or search/function-calling prompt-injection cases scored not_unsafe (also reported as robustness or success rate). Higher is better. Per category.
